limitations: Two distinct validation seeds are descriptive only; no statistical superiority claim.
Main protocol had 18 trials plus a predeclared same-seed repeat. Failures kept; repeat excluded from group means.
Adaptive maintained positive sampled proxy clearance in six main trials but failed two task endpoint tracking tests.
Forecast scores measure future fitted centers, not guaranteed true body-center accuracy or calibrated risk.
Moment-matched covariance includes model disagreement but is not a worst-case envelope or a 95% safety certificate.
No task-progress guarantee, new solver, automatic safety fallback proof, multi-robot adaptive or hardware validation.
Fixed Gazebo seed did not make complete closed-loop trajectories deterministic.
